I fixed it in `invoicing/currency.py`. The decimal-places check compared `currency.lower()` against `ZERO_DECIMAL`, which holds uppercase codes like `"JPY"`. JPY was therefore never treated as a zero-decimal currency and showed `¥14,118.50`. I changed `.lower()` to `.upper()`.

`test_invoice_jpy` now passes, along with the rest of the suite (8 tests). I didn't touch any test files.
